ucs.title: [LLM] APT37/ScarCruft ROKRAT staged HWP/LNK delivery: archive→LNK→PowerShell→cloud-C2
ucs.description: Hunts ScarCruft's signature spearphishing chain — a Korean-themed lure (HWP/HWPX/DOC) delivered inside ZIP/RAR/ISO archives that drops a malicious LNK which spawns PowerShell to fetch second-stage ROKRAT payloads from legitimate cloud services (pCloud, Yandex, Dropbox, Google Drive). This is the canonical Reaper/Group123 access chain reported by Talos, Kaspersky and S2W since 2022.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe","Bandizip.exe","Hwp.exe","Hwp70.exe","Hword.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") AND (Processes.process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.process="*pcloud*" OR Processes.process="*yandex*" OR Processes.process="*dropbox*api*" OR Processes.process="*googleapis*" OR Processes.process="*-enc*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*.hwp*" OR Processes.process="*.hwpx*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$") | rename dest as host | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ArchiveOpeners = dynamic(["7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe","Bandizip.exe","explorer.exe","ALZip.exe"]);
let HwpHosts = dynamic(["Hwp.exe","Hwp70.exe","Hword.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe"]);
let Lolbins = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe"]);
let ScarCruftC2 = dynamic(["pcloud.com","api.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","disk.yandex.net","api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","www.googleapis.com","oauth2.googleapis.com","api.box.com"]);
let SuspiciousCmd = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ArchiveOpeners) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (HwpHosts) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (".lnk", ".hwp", ".hwpx")
    | where FileName in~ (Lolbins)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-nop","-noprofile")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (ScarCruftC2)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Child = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
let CloudC2 = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (Lolbins)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (ScarCruftC2)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP,
              NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
SuspiciousCmd
| join kind=inner CloudC2 on DeviceName
| where NetTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 10m)
| project Timestamp, NetTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, Timestamp),
          DeviceName, AccountName, Parent, ParentCmd, Child, ChildCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ArchiveOpeners = dynamic(["7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe","Bandizip.exe","explorer.exe","ALZip.exe"]);
let HwpHosts = dynamic(["Hwp.exe","Hwp70.exe","Hword.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe"]);
let Lolbins = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe"]);
let ScarCruftC2 = dynamic(["pcloud.com","yandex.net","dropboxapi.com","googleapis.com","box.com"]);
let Procs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]),
             ChildName  = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where ParentName in~ (ArchiveOpeners) or ParentName in~ (HwpHosts) or CommandLine has_any (".lnk", ".hwp", ".hwpx")
    | where ChildName in~ (Lolbins)
    | where CommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-nop")
         or CommandLine has_any (ScarCruftC2)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentName, ChildName, CommandLine, NewProcessName;
let Net = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend Image = tostring(split(SourceProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where Image in~ (Lolbins)
    | where RequestURL has_any (ScarCruftC2) or DestinationHostName has_any (ScarCruftC2)
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RequestURL, DestinationHostName, DestinationIP, Image;
Procs
| join kind=inner Net on Computer
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 10m)
| project ProcTime, NetTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime),
          Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentName, ChildName, CommandLine, RequestURL, DestinationHostName, DestinationIP
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft Archive-to-LNK PowerShell Cloud C2 Chain
id: 7b3c7a4e-ap37-4d6a-b2e1-rokrat0001a
status: experimental
description: Detects ScarCruft (APT37/Reaper) staged delivery where an archive opener or HWP host spawns PowerShell/MSHTA fetching second-stage ROKRAT payloads from legitimate cloud services (pCloud/Yandex/Dropbox/Google Drive/Box).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/rokrat-rises-again/
  - https://securelist.com/scarcruft-surveillance-tools/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.command-and-control
  - attack.t1102.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\WinRAR.exe'
      - '\Bandizip.exe'
      - '\ALZip.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\Hwp.exe'
      - '\Hwp70.exe'
      - '\Hword.exe'
      - '\winword.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'IEX'
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-windowstyle hidden'
      - 'pcloud.com'
      - 'yandex.net'
      - 'dropboxapi.com'
      - 'googleapis.com'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Korean office automation scripts launched from HWP/Word that legitimately use cloud APIs (rare, validate per-environment)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @ParentImage:(*\7zFM.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\Bandizip.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Hwp.exe OR *\Hwp70.exe OR *\Hword.exe OR *\winword.exe OR *\7ZFM.EXE OR *\WINRAR.EXE OR *\HWP.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe) @CommandLine:(*-enc* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *IEX* OR *pcloud* OR *yandex* OR *dropboxapi* OR *googleapis* OR *".hwp"* OR *".lnk"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(7zFM|WinRAR|Bandizip|ALZip|explorer|Hwp|Hwp70|Hword|winword|excel)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|cmd|rundll32|regsvr32|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("(-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|IEX|Invoke-Expression|-w hidden|-windowstyle hidden|pcloud\.com|yandex\.net|dropboxapi\.com|googleapis\.com|\.hwp|\.lnk)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest | DomainName=/(pcloud\.com|yandex\.net|dropboxapi\.com|googleapis\.com|box\.com)$/i}, field=aid, include=[DomainName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, DomainName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect(CommandLine, limit=3)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Highly ScarCruft-specific: (a) parent set includes Korean-locale HWP processes (Hwp.exe/Hwp70.exe/Hword.exe) — almost no other named APT pivots through Hancom Office; (b) the archive→LNK→PowerShell handoff is the documented ROKRAT/Chinotto/M2RAT delivery chain (Talos 'ROKRAT Rises Again', Kaspersky, S2W 2022-2024 reporting); (c) the C2 allow-list (pCloud, Yandex Disk, Dropbox, Google Drive, Box) i

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 RoKRAT/Chinotto cloud-API token C2 beacon from non-browser process
ucs.description: Hunts ROKRAT's distinctive C2 behavior: a non-browser, often LOLBin or unsigned binary in user-writable paths beaconing to pCloud/Yandex/Dropbox cloud-storage APIs with bearer-token auth headers — the hallmark of ScarCruft's late-stage cloud-storage C2 (T1102.002, T1132.001).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(All_Traffic.dest) as dst values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dport values(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="api.pcloud.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*pcloud.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="cloud-api.yandex.net" OR All_Traffic.dest="*yandex.net" OR All_Traffic.dest="api.dropboxapi.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="content.dropboxapi.com") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.user | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | where NOT match(process_name,"(?i)(chrome|firefox|msedge|brave|opera|iexplore|outlook|teams|onedrive|googledrivesync|dropbox)\.exe") AND NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$") | stats min(firstTime) as firstSeen max(lastTime) as lastSeen sum(count) as beacons sum(bytes_out) as bytes_out values(dst) as domains by src process_name user | where beacons > 5 | convert ctime(firstSeen) ctime(lastSeen)
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ScarCruftCloudC2 = dynamic([
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","disk.yandex.net","yandex.net",
    "api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com",
    "www.googleapis.com","oauth2.googleapis.com",
    "api.box.com"
]);
let LegitClients = dynamic([
    "chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe",
    "iexplore.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","onedrive.exe",
    "googledrivesync.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe",
    "pcloud drive.exe","box.exe","boxedit.exe"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (ScarCruftCloudC2)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (LegitClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (
    @"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\",
    @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Windows\Tasks\")
  or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
    "powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe",
    "regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe")
| summarize Beacons = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctDomains = dcount(RemoteUrl),
            Domains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 8),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            SampleHash = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256),
            FolderPath = any(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
        by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where Beacons >= 5            // 5 = empirical: real ROKRAT beacons in 24h
| extend BeaconDurationMin = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where BeaconDurationMin >= 15 // exclude one-shot legit API touches
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ScarCruftCloudC2 = dynamic([
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","disk.yandex.net","yandex.net",
    "api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com",
    "www.googleapis.com","oauth2.googleapis.com",
    "api.box.com"
]);
let LegitClients = dynamic([
    "chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe",
    "iexplore.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","onedrive.exe",
    "googledrivesync.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe",
    "box.exe","boxedit.exe"
]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| extend Image = tolower(tostring(split(coalesce(SourceProcessName, ProcessName), "\\")[-1]))
| where DestinationHostName has_any (ScarCruftCloudC2) or RequestURL has_any (ScarCruftCloudC2)
| where Image !in (LegitClients)
| where isnotempty(Image)
| summarize Beacons = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctHosts = dcount(DestinationHostName),
            Hosts = make_set(DestinationHostName, 8),
            Urls = make_set(RequestURL, 5),
            BytesOut = sum(SentBytes)
        by SourceIP, SourceHostName, Image, SourceUserName
| where Beacons >= 5
| extend BeaconDurationMin = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where BeaconDurationMin >= 15
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR zeek OR suricata OR proxy) (@DestinationHostname:(*pcloud.com OR *yandex.net OR *dropboxapi.com OR api.box.com) OR @http.url:(*api.pcloud.com* OR *cloud-api.yandex.net* OR *dropboxapi.com* OR *box.com/2.0*)) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\teams.exe OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\dropbox.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe OR *\pCloud.exe OR *\Box.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\MSEdge.exe OR *\Firefox.exe) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest
| DomainName=/(pcloud\.com|yandex\.net|dropboxapi\.com|box\.com)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|outlook|teams|onedrive|googledrivesync|dropbox|yandexdisk|pcloud|box|boxedit)\.exe$/i
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(Users|AppData|ProgramData|Public|Temp|Downloads|Windows\\Tasks)\\/i OR ContextImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|wscript|cscript|curl|certutil)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=[count(as=beacons), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| beacons >= 5
| durationMin := (lastSeen - firstSeen)/60000
| durationMin >= 15
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: ROKRAT, Chinotto, M2RAT, and DOGCALL — the entire ScarCruft post-exploit toolkit — share the same C2 design pattern documented since 2017: HTTPS POSTs to pCloud/Yandex/Dropbox APIs with hardcoded OAuth bearer tokens.
